description: Import companies from a HubSpot list, view, or segment into a saved Saber company list.

name.description: A human-readable name for the imported list (1–200 characters)

source.description: Describes the external source to import companies from

filter.description: A single HubSpot property filter used to select companies for import

operator.description:
Comparison operator. Value-free operators (`HAS_PROPERTY`, `NOT_HAS_PROPERTY`)
do not require a `value` field. All others do.

propertyName.description: The HubSpot company property to filter on (e.g. `industry`, `city`, `hs_lead_status`)

value.description: The value to compare against. Required for all operators except `HAS_PROPERTY` and `NOT_HAS_PROPERTY`.

type.description: Import source type. Currently only `hubspot` is supported.

name: company_lists-import
